olympus.codex.page.1:
§6§lCodex of Olympus§r

The gods walk among you. Each mortal is claimed by one of the twelve Olympians and receives their starter relic.

Carry at most §l3§r god items. They drop when you die, and others may claim them.
olympus.codex.page.10:
§lLyre of Apollo§r
§7Starter relic (claiming / God Swapper)§r

Right-click: you and allies within 8 blocks get Regeneration II and Speed I for 5s, and are cleansed of Poison and Wither.

§b✦ Sunburst:§r Sets hostile mobs within 8 blocks ablaze and blinds enemies for 3s.
olympus.codex.page.11:
§lSilver Bow§r
§7Starter relic (claiming / God Swapper)§r

Arrows fly perfectly straight, deal 15% more damage, and anything they hit glows for 5s.

§b✦ Volley:§r Your next shot fires 5 arrows in a spread for the cost of one (within 10s).
olympus.codex.page.12:
§lTalaria§r
§7Starter relic (claiming / God Swapper)§r

Permanent Speed I and a double jump while worn.

§b✦ Wings of Hermes:§r Triple jump, and you never take fall damage.
olympus.codex.page.13:
§lHammer of Hephaestus§r
§7Starter relic (claiming / God Swapper)§r

Hits set enemies ablaze for 4s, you're immune to fire while holding it, and mined ores come out smelted.

§b✦ Forge Fire:§r Instantly smelts up to 16 items from the stack in your offhand.
olympus.codex.page.14:
§lSickle of Demeter§r
§7Starter relic (claiming / God Swapper)§r

Famine: hits cause Hunger and Slowness and drain 2 food from players. Right-click crops to ripen a 5x5 area.

§b✦ Great Harvest:§r Harvests and replants every ripe crop in a 9x9 area.
olympus.codex.page.15:
§lGoblet of Dionysus§r
§7Starter relic (claiming / God Swapper)§r

Drink: a random level II combat blessing for 30s (10% chance of a hangover instead). Never empties.

§b✦ Wild Party:§r Allies within 8 blocks get a random blessing for 30s; enemies stagger drunkenly.
olympus.codex.page.16:
§lMirror of Aphrodite§r
§7Starter relic (claiming / God Swapper)§r

Enchanting Gaze: the player you look at can't hurt you for 3s and is slowed. Nearby hostile mobs also leave you alone.

§b✦ Charm:§r The mob you look at fights for you for 15s. Bosses and players resist.
olympus.codex.page.17:
§lCaduceus§r
§7Crafted (see RECIPES / recipe book)§r

Right-click: blink up to 10 blocks where you look (never through walls).

§b✦ Waypoint:§r First press marks your spot; press again within 5 minutes to return to it.
olympus.codex.page.18:
§lSpear of Athena§r
§7Crafted (see RECIPES / recipe book)§r

A thrown spear that pierces up to 3 enemies and always returns to you.

§b✦ Aegis Strike:§r Your next throw lands with a shockwave that knocks back and slows enemies within 4 blocks.
olympus.codex.page.19:
§lForge Hammer§r
§7Crafted (see RECIPES / recipe book)§r

Mines a 3x3 area (sneak to mine a single block).

§b✦ Forge Mode:§r Switch between 3x3 and 5x5 mining.
olympus.codex.page.2:
§lRelic Rules§r

• God items never break.
• Dropped relics glow and never despawn.
• No ender chests, shulker boxes or bundles.
• Enchant them like their base item (no Unbreaking or Mending).
olympus.codex.page.20:
§lHarpe§r
§7Crafted (see RECIPES / recipe book)§r

Perseus' blade: 50% more damage against bosses.

§b✦ Hero's Leap:§r Leap at the creature you look at (up to 12 blocks) and strike it for double damage.
olympus.codex.page.21:
§lThyrsus§r
§7Crafted (see RECIPES / recipe book)§r

Hits make enemies stagger: Slowness II and dizziness for 5s.

§b✦ Vine Snare:§r Roots every enemy within 6 blocks in place for 3s.
olympus.codex.page.22:
§lCornucopia§r
§7Crafted (see RECIPES / recipe book)§r

Right-click: fully restores your hunger and saturation.

§b✦ Feast:§r Fully feeds every ally within 10 blocks and grants Regeneration.
olympus.codex.page.23:
§lThunderbolt of Zeus§r
§7Legendary: boss event reward§r

Throw it: 5 lightning strikes rain around the impact, then it returns to your hand.

§b✦ Skybreaker:§r Launch about 15 blocks into the sky and land in a ring of lightning. No fall damage.
olympus.codex.page.24:
§lTrident of Poseidon§r
§7Legendary: boss event reward§r

Release to Riptide anywhere, even on dry land, with a wave that throws enemies back. Sneak to throw: Channeling is always on.

§b✦ Earthshaker:§r Every enemy within 10 blocks is hurled into the air.
olympus.codex.page.25:
§lBident of Hades§r
§7Legendary: boss event reward§r

Right-click: 3 skeleton warriors rise to fight for you for 30s.

§b✦ Soul Harvest:§r For 15s, everything you kill rises as a skeleton ally.
olympus.codex.page.26:
§lHead of Medusa§r
§7Legendary: boss event reward§r

Look at a creature and right-click: it turns to stone for 4s (shorter on players). Wear it on your head.

§b✦ Gorgon's Gaze:§r Petrifies everything in a 10-block cone in front of you for 3s.
olympus.codex.page.27:
§lGolden Fleece§r
§7Legendary: boss event reward§r

While worn: constant Regeneration and immunity to fire.

§b✦ Undying:§r Once every 10 minutes, a killing blow leaves you standing instead.
olympus.codex.page.28:
§lScythe of Kronos§r
§7Legendary: boss event reward§r

Right-click: time freezes for everything within 15 blocks (Slowness IV, Mining Fatigue III) for 6s.

§b✦ Rewind:§r Return to where you were 5 seconds ago, with the health you had then.
olympus.codex.page.29:
§lDivine Events§r

Admins summon bosses with /olympus event start. Wrath of Zeus may strike in thunderstorms.

The top damage dealer wins the event's legendary. Everyone with 10%+ damage gets bronze, maybe a template.
olympus.codex.page.3:
§lUpgrades§r

Smithing table:

§bBlessed ★§r: Blessing Core + god item + Block of Olympian Bronze.
-25% cooldowns, unlocks the §lDivine Power§r (key R).

§6Ascended ★★§r: Ascension Core + Blessed item + bronze block. -50% cooldowns, +25% reach.
olympus.codex.page.30:
§lLegendaries§r

Each exists once per server. Lost to the void, it can drop again.

Typhon → Thunderbolt
Cetus → Poseidon's Trident
Cerberus → Bident
Medusa → Her Head
Dragon → Golden Fleece
Kronos → Scythe
olympus.codex.page.4:
§lGod Swapper§r

Hold it in your main hand, your starter relic in your offhand, and hold right-click for 3 seconds.

Your relic becomes another god's, keeping its level and every enchantment it can.
olympus.codex.page.5:
§lAegis§r
§7Starter relic (claiming / God Swapper)§r

Blocked melee hits push the attacker back, with a 30% chance to strike them with lightning.

§b✦ Divine Shockwave:§r Every 5th blocked hit releases a shockwave that knocks back and smites hostile mobs within 5 blocks.
olympus.codex.page.6:
§lConch of the Deep§r
§7Starter relic (claiming / God Swapper)§r

Tidal Surge: a wave crashes 7 blocks ahead, knocking enemies back and slowing them for 3s. You gain Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace.

§b✦ Riptide Dash:§r Launch forward like Riptide, even on dry land.
olympus.codex.page.7:
§lHelm of Darkness§r
§7Starter relic (claiming / God Swapper)§r

Sneak in place for 2s to vanish completely, armor and all, with Speed I, for 8s.

§b✦ Ambush:§r While invisible, your first hit deals 2x damage and ends the invisibility.
olympus.codex.page.8:
§lOwl of Athena§r
§7Starter relic (claiming / God Swapper)§r

Reveal: everything within 30 blocks glows for 10s and takes 15% more damage from you.

§b✦ Battle Wisdom:§r You and allies within 10 blocks gain Strength I and Resistance I for 10s.
olympus.codex.page.9:
§lBlade of Ares§r
§7Starter relic (claiming / God Swapper)§r

Fury: 3 hits in a row grant Strength I. Kills grant Strength II for 8s.

§b✦ War Cry:§r Mobs within 8 blocks are weakened; you and nearby allies gain Speed II for 10s.
